youtube.title: Why a Skyscraper Hides a Giant Golden Ball 🏙️ #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Taipei 101 contains a tuned mass damper, a steel sphere of about 660 metric tons suspended near the top. When wind or earthquakes make the tower sway, the ball swings in the opposite phase and absorbs the energy, reducing movement and keeping occupants comfortable. Many tall buildings use the same idea.
